limitations: App screenshot capture does not show the system keyboard, including files named keyboard-initial and keyboard-retry. Keyboard visibility, layout and occlusion are not visually verified.
The four states contain no confirmation alert screenshot. Native cancellation/confirmation assertions are separate evidence, not visual proof of alert layout.
Button enabled/disabled semantics and secure-field value are not established from styling or redacted/blank secure content; consult native assertions and the source receipt.
No numeric contrast or 44-point hit-target measurement is performed by this visual review.
These portrait simulator states do not cover AX5, landscape, Split View, physical devices or complete 21-state design parity.
The run executed only one DEBUG fixture deletion test per simulator (4/4 PASS); it is not a full regression suite, real-backend deletion verification, archive rerun or release approval.
Phone screenshot review is outside this document. No source PNG, raw attachment or existing receipt was modified.
